findings.text: — s72's Why asserts "the station resumed the held run anyway", but the only surviving record of that attempt is attempt-4.reservation (kind "resume", pid 1522386, supervisor_pid 2555604, host 98dci4-clu-2001, 2026-11-15T21:52:23Z), which names no launching pass, while the section's own Deliverable says the node "first reproduces the resume on a temporary crew home and names in its fragment which pass made it" — so the stated root cause (the station's pass) is asserted ahead of the evidence and contradicted by the deliverable's admission. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: the declared write path reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py fits only if the resuming pass is the fix point; if the hold was bypassed by a different door the section sends a node at the wrong module and its test proves a refusal nobody was making.

— s72's done-when specifies a held delivered run "whose newest review carries a disposed blocking finding" as the shape that resumed r-20261115T184907801020, but a review whose blocking findings are all disposed is exactly the shape recovery_repair_dispatch.py:1658 already declines ("every blocking finding was disposed: …", status decline-only), so at the base revision that fixture reserves no resume and the declared negative control ("at the base revision the first pass reserves a resume for the held run") cannot fire; the head arm's "no attempt reserved" would then hold for a reason unrelated to the hold. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: the fixture must be the base-pass-reproducing shape (an undisposed blocking finding with a delivered head), or the node passes with no control.

— the delivery hold that s72's Why places on the run at 21:05Z is stored only as the delivery_hold field of the run's live pointer (reckon/crew/resume.py:41 with runs.pointer_path = live/<run_id>.json, written through runs._mutate_pointer), and no copy of that pointer survives: live/ holds no r-20261115T184907801020.json after the run was discarded, and the run directory's records carry no hold (dispatch-detail.json admit_request.hold is {}). WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: a section whose premise no later reader can open cannot be re-checked, and s72 must cite the durable record of the hold (or record that the hold was never on the run) before a node builds against it.
